about.title: ABOUT
about.content1: **K-Tech College Hackathon 2025** is a key event within the framework of **K-Tech College 2025**, organized by **LIKELION Vietnam** in collaboration with **KOSME - Korea SMEs and Startups Agency** and **JobKorea - Korean Recruitment Platform**, with **100%** funding from the **Korean Government**.
about.content2: The event creates a **space where creativity and technology converge**, where young people can **learn, connect, discover career opportunities and collaborate with Vietnamese - Korean** enterprises in the fields of **AI, creativity, gaming and digital technology**.

faq1.question: Is there a fee to attend the event?
faq1.answer: This event is completely free of charge.

faq2.question: What are the requirements for registration?
faq2.answer: You just need to register your information on the website, note the time and location to attend the event. Additionally, please upload your CV in English or your native language when registering and bring a printed copy when attending the event if you want to have direct interviews with Korean companies.

faq3.question: Which companies will participate in this event?
faq3.answer: All are Korean technology companies with headquarters in Korea or Vietnam.

faq4.question: What job positions will be available at the event?
faq4.answer: Over 30 job positions in Korea or Vietnam for talented programmers, including fresh graduates or those with many years of experience.

faq5.question: Why do I need to register in advance?
faq5.answer: Registering & uploading your CV on the website helps recruiters review and evaluate candidates in advance before the job fair, saving time to understand participating candidates better and increasing the chances of getting a job right at the event.

faq6.question: Do companies require foreign language skills during interviews?
faq6.answer: Having foreign language skills will be an advantage when interviewing and communicating with companies. However, if you are not confident about your language abilities, please rest assured as the event will have interpreters to support candidates during conversations and direct interviews.

faq7.question: Is it required to attend the entire event?
faq7.answer: The program does not mandate that you must participate in the entire event. However, we strongly encourage you to spend time exploring the various activities to familiarize yourself with the event and find the job that best suits you.

section1.title: 1. Purpose:
section1.content1: This Privacy Policy governs the manner in which we collect, use, and disclose your personal information when you access and use this website (ktechjobfair.likelion.edu.vn).
section1.content2: This website is operated by LIKELION VIETNAM LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY (hereinafter referred to as "Company", "we" or "our").

section2.title: 2. Types of Information We Collect:
section2.intro: We collect two main types of information from you:

subsectionA.title: a. Contact Information & Work Experience:
subsectionA.content: This is information that can be used to contact you, such as name, email address, phone number, current position, years of experience, major, and CV. We collect this information when you register for the job fair event.

subsectionB.title: b. Other Information:
subsectionB.content: This is information that cannot be used to identify you, such as IP address, web browser, and device type. We collect this non-personal information through the use of cookies and other technologies.

subsectionA.title: a. We use your information for the following purposes:
subsectionA.item1: To process your registration for the job fair event
subsectionA.item2: To evaluate your profile for job opportunities
subsectionA.item3: To contact you about job fairs and other opportunities
subsectionA.item4: To improve our Website and services
subsectionA.item5: To comply with our legal obligations

subsectionB.title: b. How We Share Your Information:
subsectionB.intro: We may share your information with the following third parties:

provider.title: Service Providers:
provider.content: We may share your information with service providers who help us operate the Website and provide our services, such as email service providers, SMS providers, and hosting service providers.

employer.title: Employers:
employer.content: We may share your information with employers who have job opportunities that match your profile.

law.title: Law Enforcement:
law.content: We may share your information with law enforcement agencies if we believe it is necessary to comply with the law or protect our rights, yours, or those of others.

section4.title: 4. Your Choices:
section4.content1: You may choose not to provide personal information to us. However, if you do not provide personal information, you may not be able to register for the job fair event or use certain features of the website.
section4.content2: You may also choose to unsubscribe from receiving marketing emails from us. To unsubscribe, please click the unsubscribe link in any marketing email you receive from us.

section5.title: 5. Security of Your Information:
section5.content: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. However, we cannot guarantee that your information will be secure from all security breaches.

section6.title: 6. Changes to This Policy:
section6.content: We may change this Policy at any time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the updated version of this Policy on the Website.

section7.title: 7. Contact Us:
section7.content: If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact us via email
